checks.lead: Jawaharlal Nehru (14 November 1889 – 27 May 1964) was an Indian anti-colonial nationalist, lawyer, and politician who was the first Prime Minister of India from 1947 to 1960. Nehru was a principal leader of the Indian nationalist movement, and his premiership majorly influenced India's arc as a modern nation.
